reason: Substantial rework of GraphQL content-field filtering (alias resolution, predicate query aliasing, index provider wiring, moved/renamed classes and public interfaces) touches core query-building logic used across all content-driven GraphQL queries, so subtle regressions in filter behavior for existing sites/modules are plausible despite added tests.
